name: Turkey Chili-Style Soup with White Beans, Peppers & Bread Crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 green bell peppers
3 red bell peppers
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg ground turkey
2 tbsp chili powder
2 ½ tsp garlic powder
2 tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the turkey is done, add veggies to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add beans, broth, tomatoes, and hot sauce to the pot; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
2 tbsp hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add bread crumbs and cook, stirring frequently, until golden brown, about 4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to the bowl with the parsley and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with parsley bread crumbs. Enjoy!
